title: Counit comparison for a flat complex on a base open
statement: Let $B,A$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], $g:A\to B$ a morphism and $a\in A$. Let $S\subset B$ and $V\subset A$ be opens with $g(a)\in S$, $a\in V$ and $V\subset g^{-1}(S)$, and put $j=g|_V:V\to S$. Let $K$ be a bounded-above complex of flat $\mathcal O_S$-module sheaves [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. Put $R=\mathcal O_{B,g(a)}$, $T=\mathcal O_{A,a}$, $x_S=(g(a),g(a)\in S)$, $x_V=(a,a\in V)$, $P=K_{x_S}$ with scalars transported along the inverse $\mathcal O_{S,x_S}\simeq R$, and let $F$ be the stalk functor at $x_V$ followed by scalar restriction along the inverse $\mathcal O_{V,x_V}\simeq T$. Let $LF:D(R)\to D(T)$ and $\varepsilon:LF\circ Q_h\to Q_h\circ\operatorname{extendScalars}(g_a)$ be any universal left-derived pair for extension along the stalk map $g_a:R\to T$. For each $n\in\mathbf Z$ there are $T$-linear isomorphisms $l:F(H^n(Lj^*(Q_h(K))))\simeq H^n(LF(Q_h(P)))$ and $r:H^n(Q_h(\operatorname{extendScalars}(g_a)(P)))\simeq F(H^n(Q_h(j^*K)))$. They satisfy $F(H^n(\operatorname{counit}_j(K)))=r\circ H^n(\varepsilon_P)\circ l$. Here $Q_h$ includes passage to the homotopy category, $j^*$ is ordinary tensor pullback, and $\operatorname{counit}_j$ is its fixed left-derived comparison [def-pc-standard-single-flat-counit-presentation]. All derived categories are standard [def-pc-derived-category]; stalks are [def-pc-module-stalk-functor]. This statement involves no direct image or coefficient module.

proof.text: Bounded-above flatness gives K-flatness of K. Use the pinned pullback counit invertibility proof from SingleComplexBaseChangeStalkCondition. The stalk criterion gives K-flatness of Q; ringIso_kFlat from StalkKFlatTensorHomology transports it along the inverse open stalk-ring isomorphism to categorical K-flatness of P. The proved scalarExtension_quasiIso_of_kFlat helper from KFlatScalarExtensionDerivedIso supplies PreservesKFlatQuasiIso for scalar extension. Apply the source-library Functor.isLeftDerivedFunctor_iff_isIso_app_of_kFlat directly to hLF and P to make the given scalar counit invertible, without a round trip through the acyclic-tensor predicate.

The private proved extensionComplexIso uses the equivalences given by scalar restriction along the two ring isomorphisms. Mathlib restrictScalarsComp and restrictScalarsComp′ identify the right adjoints of the two composite scalar functors, using the commuting ring-map square. Mathlib conjugateIsoEquiv gives the corresponding isomorphism of left adjoints. Apply it termwise with NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex and the composition factors, then compose with extension of the supplied input chain isomorphism q. This constructs the ordinary chain isomorphism without using any base-derived tensor cohomology model or comparison.

Use Mathlib resLEStalkMap and stalkMap_congr_point to identify the conjugated open stalk map with g.stalkMap a. Apply extensionComplexIso, then compose with the tensor-pullback stalk chain isomorphism. The private tensorStalkIsoAt helper performs equal-point transport and termwise-composition factors. Apply derived homology and the exact stalk/restriction homology factors to obtain the target isomorphism r.

Let c be the stalk of degree-n homology of the invertible pinned sheaf counit, and e degree-n homology of the invertible scalar counit. Define l = c followed by inverse r followed by inverse e. Then l.hom followed by e.hom followed by r.hom equals c.hom by inverse identities and associativity. This is the existing cancellation proof; no chosen natural derived comparison is required.
